dropped.claim: EPAM demonstrates genuine revenue recovery at 15.4% growth and exceptional cash generation with $654.9M operating cash flow exceeding $377.7M net income, but the concerning divergence between topline acceleration and profitability deterioration—operating income declining to $520.0M from $544.6M despite revenue growing $800M—suggests margin pressure that management attributes to Ukraine-related costs expected to continue for some time, creating uncertainty about whether FY2026 will show operating leverage or continued compression.
